ListUnitPrice MUST NOT reflect any unit price impact dependent on a discount-bearing commitment program being applied to the charge.

items.b: Describes the pricing model used for a charge at the time of use or purchase. The pricing model applied to a charge at the time of use or purchase, useful for separating list-price from reduced-price charges and spotting chances to raise commitment discount coverage. A Conditional String under the Includes Multiple Pricing Categories condition, it must be null when SkuPriceId is null or ChargeCategory is "Tax", must not be null for "Usage" or "Purchase" charges whose ChargeClass is not "Correction", and may be null otherwise. Allowed values are "Standard" (the billing account's agreed rate, including commitment discount purchases), "Committed" (reduced by an existing commitment discount), "Dynamic" (provider-determined rates that may change) and "Other".
items.s: Column in Cost and Usage · Conditional · Dimension · String
items.x: Includes Multiple Pricing Categories Value Description Standard Charges priced at the agreed upon rate for the billing account, including negotiated discounts. This pricing includes any flat rate and volume/tiered pricing but does not include dynamic pricing or reduced pricing due to the application of a commitment discount. This does include the purchase of a commitment discount at agreed upon rates. Dynamic Charges priced at a variable rate determined by the service provider. This includes any product or service with a unit price the service provider can change without notice, like interruptible or low priority resources. Committed Charges with reduced pricing due to the application of the commitment discount specified by the Commitment Discount ID. Other Charges priced in a way not covered by another pricing category.

items.t: PricingCategory MUST adhere to the following requirements:
PricingCategory MUST be of type String.
PricingCategory MUST adhere to the following nullability requirements:
PricingCategory MUST be null when SkuPriceId is null.
PricingCategory MUST be null when ChargeCategory is "Tax".
PricingCategory MUST NOT be null when ChargeCategory is "Usage" or "Purchase" and ChargeClass is not "Correction".
PricingCategory MAY be null in all other cases.
When PricingCategory is not null, PricingCategory MUST adhere to the following requirements:
PricingCategory MUST be one of the allowed values.
PricingCategory MUST be "Standard" when pricing is predetermined at the agreed upon rate for the billing account.
PricingCategory MUST be "Committed" when the charge is subject to an existing commitment discount and is not the purchase of the commitment discount.
PricingCategory MUST be "Dynamic" when pricing is determined by the service provider and may change over time, regardless of predetermined agreement pricing.
PricingCategory MUST be "Other" when there is a pricing model but none of the allowed values apply.

items.b: The national or consumption currency denomination that a resource or service was priced in. The national or consumption currency in which a resource or service was priced, commonly used where pricing and billing are in different currencies. In the CostAndUsage dataset it is a Conditional String dimension, applying under the Includes Pricing-Billing Currency Differences operating model condition, that must conform to the String Handling and Currency Format requirements and must not be null. It must represent a national currency or a consumption currency, and documentation for the column must specify how to determine whether a value represents a national currency and must be accessible to practitioners.
items.s: Column in Cost and Usage · Conditional · Dimension · String

items.t: PricingCurrency MUST adhere to the following requirements:
PricingCurrency MUST be of type String.
PricingCurrency MUST conform to StringHandling requirements.
PricingCurrency MUST conform to CurrencyFormat requirements.
PricingCurrency MUST NOT be null.
PricingCurrency MUST represent a national currency or a consumption currency.
PricingCurrency documentation MUST adhere to the following requirements:
PricingCurrency documentation MUST specify how to determine whether a value represents a national currency.
PricingCurrency documentation MUST be accessible to practitioners.

items.b: The negotiated unit price per Pricing Unit for the SKU Price identified by the given SKU Price ID, expressed in Pricing Currency. The negotiated unit price per Pricing Unit for the SKU Price identified by SkuPriceId, in PricingCurrency, before any currency exchange rate conversion or discount-bearing commitment program. It is a non-negative Decimal. It must be null when SkuPriceId is null or ChargeCategory is "Tax", and must not be null when SkuPriceId is not null or on "Usage" and "Purchase" rows that are not corrections. It must reflect negotiated non-foreign-exchange pricing terms, must not reflect commitment-dependent price effects, and must equal PricingCurrencyListUnitPrice when no such terms apply. Values should not be aggregated into totals. The feature level is Conditional.
items.s: Column in Cost and Usage · Conditional · Metric · Decimal

items.t: PricingCurrencyContractedUnitPrice MUST adhere to the following requirements:
PricingCurrencyContractedUnitPrice MUST be of type Decimal.
PricingCurrencyContractedUnitPrice MUST conform to NumericFormat requirements.
PricingCurrencyContractedUnitPrice MUST adhere to the following nullability requirements:
PricingCurrencyContractedUnitPrice MUST be null when SkuPriceId is null.
PricingCurrencyContractedUnitPrice MUST be null when ChargeCategory is "Tax".
PricingCurrencyContractedUnitPrice MUST NOT be null when SkuPriceId is not null.
PricingCurrencyContractedUnitPrice MUST NOT be null when ChargeCategory is "Usage" or "Purchase" and ChargeClass is not "Correction".
PricingCurrencyContractedUnitPrice MAY be null in all other cases.
When PricingCurrencyContractedUnitPrice is not null, PricingCurrencyContractedUnitPrice MUST adhere to the following requirements:
PricingCurrencyContractedUnitPrice MUST be a non-negative decimal value.
PricingCurrencyContractedUnitPrice MUST be denominated in the PricingCurrency.

PricingCurrencyContractedUnitPrice MUST reflect negotiated non-FX pricing terms for the SKU Price identified by the given SkuPriceId that are independent of any discount-bearing commitment programs being applied to the charge.
PricingCurrencyContractedUnitPrice MUST NOT reflect any unit price impact dependent on a discount-bearing commitment program being applied to the charge.
PricingCurrencyContractedUnitPrice MUST equal PricingCurrencyListUnitPrice when no negotiated non-FX pricing terms apply to the charge.

items.b: The Pricing Currency-denominated equivalent of Effective Cost, representing the cost of a charge based on the resources used, services used, or contract commitments recognized in a given charge period. EffectiveCost expressed in the PricingCurrency, with the same pricing adjustments, amortizations and exclusions but before any exchange rate conversion to the BillingCurrency. It gives a uniform baseline before converting from a consumption currency, such as platform credits, to a national currency, or from one national currency to another, and supports accrual-based reporting, forecasting and cost allocation. This Conditional Decimal must not be null and must be denominated in the PricingCurrency. It must be included when the operating model includes a consumption currency, and should be included when it includes pricing and billing currency differences.
items.s: Column in Cost and Usage · Conditional · Metric · Decimal

items.t: PricingCurrencyEffectiveCost MUST adhere to the following requirements:
PricingCurrencyEffectiveCost MUST be of type Decimal.
PricingCurrencyEffectiveCost MUST conform to NumericFormat requirements.
PricingCurrencyEffectiveCost MUST NOT be null.
PricingCurrencyEffectiveCost MUST be denominated in the PricingCurrency.
PricingCurrencyEffectiveCost MUST be the PricingCurrency-denominated equivalent of EffectiveCost, before any currency exchange rate conversion.

items.b: The service-provider-suggested unit price per Pricing Unit for the SKU Price identified by the given SKU Price ID, expressed in Pricing Currency. The service-provider-suggested unit price per Pricing Unit for the SKU Price identified by SkuPriceId, in PricingCurrency, before any negotiated pricing terms or discount-bearing commitment programs such as commitment discounts; it is commonly used for negotiation and rate optimization. It is a non-negative Decimal. It must be null when SkuPriceId is null or ChargeCategory is "Tax", and must not be null when SkuPriceId is not null or on non-correction "Usage" and "Purchase" rows. It must not reflect negotiated pricing terms or commitment-dependent price effects. Values should not be aggregated into totals. The feature level is Conditional.
items.s: Column in Cost and Usage · Conditional · Metric · Decimal

items.t: PricingCurrencyListUnitPrice MUST adhere to the following requirements:
PricingCurrencyListUnitPrice MUST be of type Decimal.
PricingCurrencyListUnitPrice MUST conform to NumericFormat requirements.
PricingCurrencyListUnitPrice MUST adhere to the following nullability requirements:
PricingCurrencyListUnitPrice MUST be null when SkuPriceId is null.
PricingCurrencyListUnitPrice MUST be null when ChargeCategory is "Tax".
PricingCurrencyListUnitPrice MUST NOT be null when SkuPriceId is not null.
PricingCurrencyListUnitPrice MUST NOT be null when ChargeCategory is "Usage" or "Purchase" and ChargeClass is not "Correction".
PricingCurrencyListUnitPrice MAY be null in all other cases.
When PricingCurrencyListUnitPrice is not null, PricingCurrencyListUnitPrice MUST adhere to the following requirements:
PricingCurrencyListUnitPrice MUST be a non-negative decimal value.
PricingCurrencyListUnitPrice MUST be denominated in the PricingCurrency.
PricingCurrencyListUnitPrice MUST represent the service-provider-suggested unit price per PricingUnit for the SKU Price identified by the given SkuPriceId.
PricingCurrencyListUnitPrice MUST NOT reflect negotiated pricing terms for the associated SKU Price.
PricingCurrencyListUnitPrice MUST NOT reflect any unit price impact dependent on a discount-bearing commitment program being applied to the charge.

items.b: The volume of a given SKU associated with a resource or service used or purchased, based on the Pricing Unit. The volume of a stock keeping unit (SKU) used or purchased for a resource or service, based on the PricingUnit. Unlike ConsumedQuantity, it focuses on pricing and cost rather than consumption. A Mandatory Decimal metric in Numeric Format, it must be null when SkuPriceId is null or ChargeCategory is "Tax", must not be null for "Usage" or "Purchase" charges whose ChargeClass is not "Correction", and may be null otherwise. When aggregating per SkuId for a SKU with both covering and covered charges, exclude covered charges on a billed basis or covering charges on an accrual basis to avoid double counting.
items.s: Column in Cost and Usage · Mandatory · Metric · Decimal

items.t: PricingQuantity MUST adhere to the following requirements:
PricingQuantity MUST be of type Decimal.
PricingQuantity MUST conform to NumericFormat requirements.
PricingQuantity MUST adhere to the following nullability requirements:
PricingQuantity MUST be null when SkuPriceId is null.
PricingQuantity MUST be null when ChargeCategory is "Tax".
PricingQuantity MUST NOT be null when ChargeCategory is "Usage" or "Purchase" and ChargeClass is not "Correction".
PricingQuantity MAY be null in all other cases.

items.b: Service-provider-specified measurement unit for determining unit prices, indicating how the service provider rates measured usage and purchase quantities after applying pricing rules like block pricing. The service-provider-specified measurement unit for determining unit prices, showing how the provider rates measured usage and purchase quantities after pricing rules such as block pricing, for example Hours, GB-Hours or 1000 Requests. It complements PricingQuantity and, unlike ConsumedUnit, concerns pricing rather than consumption, often at a coarser granularity. Though Mandatory, it allows nulls: it must be null when PricingQuantity is null and must not be null otherwise. This String should follow unit format requirements and, when present, must be semantically equal to the pricing unit in the provider's published price list, and on the invoice where one appears.
items.s: Column in Cost and Usage · Mandatory · Dimension · String

items.t: PricingUnit MUST adhere to the following requirements:
PricingUnit MUST be of type String.
PricingUnit MUST conform to StringHandling requirements.
PricingUnit SHOULD conform to UnitFormat requirements.
PricingUnit MUST adhere to the following nullability requirements:
PricingUnit MUST be null when PricingQuantity is null.
PricingUnit MUST NOT be null when PricingQuantity is not null.
When PricingUnit is not null, PricingUnit MUST adhere to the following requirements:
PricingUnit MUST be semantically equal to the corresponding pricing measurement unit provided in service-provider-published price list.
PricingUnit MUST be semantically equal to the corresponding pricing measurement unit provided in invoice, when the invoice includes a pricing measurement unit.

items.b: Identifier representing the principal to which access to a resource or service is granted. An identifier for the principal to which access to a resource or service is granted, used to report and audit cost by principal; its descriptive attributes sit in RequesterDetails. It is a Conditional String dimension under the Includes Requester Attribution operating model condition. It must be null when a charge has no principal or the principal has no published identifier, and must not be null when it has one. When present it must reference a principal and be unique within the service provider, and must not contain a value that authenticates a request, such as an access token or password.
items.s: Column in Cost and Usage · Conditional · Dimension · String

items.t: PrincipalId MUST adhere to the following requirements:
PrincipalId MUST be of type String.
PrincipalId MUST conform to StringHandling requirements.
PrincipalId MUST adhere to the following nullability requirements:
PrincipalId MUST be null when a charge is not associated with a principal.
PrincipalId MUST be null when the principal associated with a charge has no published identifier.
PrincipalId MUST NOT be null when the principal associated with a charge has a published identifier.
When PrincipalId is not null, PrincipalId MUST adhere to the following requirements:
PrincipalId MUST be an identifier that references a principal.
PrincipalId MUST be a unique identifier within the service provider.
PrincipalId MUST NOT contain a value that authenticates a request (e.g., an API key string, an access token, a password).

items.b: Host-provider-assigned identifier for an isolated geographic area where a resource is provisioned or a service is provided. A host-provider-assigned identifier for the isolated geographic area where a resource is provisioned or a service is provided, commonly used to analyze cost and unit prices by where resources are deployed. It is a Conditional string, tied to operating models that include regions, and must conform to the String Handling requirements. It must not be null when a resource or service is operated in or managed from a distinct region, and it may be null when it is not.
items.s: Column in Cost and Usage · Conditional · Dimension · String

items.t: RegionId MUST adhere to the following requirements:
RegionId MUST be of type String.
RegionId MUST conform to StringHandling requirements.
RegionId MUST adhere to the following nullability requirements:
RegionId MUST NOT be null when a resource or service is operated in or managed from a distinct region.
RegionId MAY be null when a resource or service is not operated in or managed from a distinct region.

items.b: The name of an isolated geographic area where a resource is provisioned or a service is provided. The host-provider-assigned display name of the isolated geographic area where a resource is provisioned or a service is provided, commonly used to analyze cost and unit prices by where resources are deployed. This Conditional string, tied to operating models that include regions, must conform to the String Handling requirements. Its nullability follows RegionId: it must be null when RegionId is null and must not be null when RegionId is not null.
items.s: Column in Cost and Usage · Conditional · Dimension · String

items.t: RegionName MUST adhere to the following requirements:
RegionName MUST be of type String.
RegionName MUST conform to StringHandling requirements.
RegionName MUST adhere to the following nullability requirements:
RegionName MUST be null when RegionId is null.
RegionName MUST NOT be null when RegionId is not null.

items.b: A set of properties describing the requester associated with a charge. CostAndUsage.RequesterDetails (Requester Details) is a column describing the requester behind a charge: the principal granted access and the credential that authenticated it. It complements the opaque PrincipalId and CredentialId. It is a JSON array of key-value entries; Principal and Credential entries may carry Type, Name and Email. Feature level is Conditional, under the Includes Requester Attribution condition. It must not be null when PrincipalId or CredentialId is not null, and may be null when both are null. A Principal or Credential entry must not appear when its ID is null. Keys must be unique. Introduced in version 1.5.
items.s: Column in Cost and Usage · Conditional · Dimension · JSON

items.t: RequesterDetails MUST adhere to the following requirements:
RequesterDetails MUST be of type JSON Array (serialized as a String where necessary).
RequesterDetails MUST conform to StringHandling requirements.
RequesterDetails MUST conform to JsonObjectFormat requirements.
RequesterDetails MUST adhere to the following nullability requirements:
RequesterDetails MUST NOT be null when PrincipalId is not null or CredentialId is not null.
RequesterDetails MAY be null when PrincipalId is null and CredentialId is null.
RequesterDetails MUST conform to RequesterDetailsObject requirements when RequesterDetails is not null.

items.b: Identifier assigned to a resource by the service provider. The identifier a service provider assigns to a resource, commonly used for cost reporting, analysis and allocation. It is a Conditional String dimension in the CostAndUsage dataset, applying under the Includes Provisioned Resources operating model condition, and must conform to the String Handling requirements. It must be null when a charge is not related to a resource and must not be null when it is. When present, it must be unique within the service provider, should be a fully qualified identifier, and, when CommitmentDiscountStatus is "Used", must identify the resource that received the commitment discount.
items.s: Column in Cost and Usage · Conditional · Dimension · String

items.t: ResourceId MUST adhere to the following requirements:
ResourceId MUST be of type String.
ResourceId MUST conform to StringHandling requirements.
ResourceId MUST adhere to the following nullability requirements:
ResourceId MUST be null when a charge is not related to a resource.
ResourceId MUST NOT be null when a charge is related to a resource.
When ResourceId is not null, ResourceId MUST adhere to the following requirements:
ResourceId MUST be a unique identifier within the service provider.
ResourceId SHOULD be a fully-qualified identifier.
ResourceId MUST be the identifier of the resource that received the commitment discount when CommitmentDiscountStatus is "Used".

items.b: Display name assigned to a resource. The display name assigned to a resource, commonly used for cost analysis, reporting and allocation. It is a Conditional String dimension, applying when the operating model includes provisioned resources, and must conform to the String Handling requirements. It must be null when ResourceId is null or the resource has no assigned display name, and must not be null when ResourceId is not null and the resource has an assigned display name. It must not duplicate ResourceId when the resource is not provisioned interactively or only has a system-generated ResourceId.
items.s: Column in Cost and Usage · Conditional · Dimension · String

items.t: ResourceName MUST adhere to the following requirements:
ResourceName MUST be of type String.
ResourceName MUST conform to StringHandling requirements.
ResourceName MUST adhere to the following nullability requirements:
ResourceName MUST be null when ResourceId is null or when the resource does not have an assigned display name.
ResourceName MUST NOT be null when ResourceId is not null and the resource has an assigned display name.
ResourceName MUST NOT duplicate ResourceId when the resource is not provisioned interactively or only has a system-generated ResourceId.

items.b: The kind of resource the charge applies to. The kind of resource a charge applies to, such as Virtual Machine, Data Warehouse or Load Balancer, commonly used to identify cost changes in groups of similar resources. It is a Conditional String dimension in the CostAndUsage dataset, under both the Includes Provisioned Resources and Includes Resource Type Assignment operating model conditions, and must follow string handling requirements. It must be null when ResourceId is null and must not be null when ResourceId is not null. No allowed values or value format are defined.
items.s: Column in Cost and Usage · Conditional · Dimension · String
items.x: Includes Provisioned Resources and Includes Resource Type Assignment

items.t: ResourceType MUST adhere to the following requirements:
ResourceType MUST be of type String.
ResourceType MUST conform to StringHandling requirements.
ResourceType MUST adhere to the following nullability requirements:
ResourceType MUST be null when ResourceId is null.
ResourceType MUST NOT be null when ResourceId is not null.

items.b: Highest-level classification of a service based on the core function of the service. The highest-level classification of a service by its core function, used for analyzing costs across service providers and tracking workload migration across fundamentally different architectures; each service should have one and only one category, the one that best aligns with its primary purpose. It is a Mandatory String dimension that must not be null and must be one of nineteen allowed values, among them Compute, Storage, Databases, Networking, Analytics, Security and Identity, with Other for new or emerging services that do not align with an existing category.
items.s: Column in Cost and Usage · Mandatory · Dimension · String

items.t: ServiceCategory MUST adhere to the following requirements:
ServiceCategory MUST be of type String.
ServiceCategory MUST NOT be null.
ServiceCategory MUST be one of the allowed values.

items.b: An offering that can be purchased from a service provider (e.g., cloud virtual machine, SaaS database, professional services from a systems integrator). The display name of the service offering purchased from a service provider, such as a cloud virtual machine, a software-as-a-service database or professional services from a systems integrator; one service can include several kinds of charges, such as compute, storage and networking. Commonly used to analyze aggregate cost trends and filter data to investigate anomalies, it is a mandatory String dimension that must not be null and must follow string handling requirements. Each ServiceName must have exactly one ServiceCategory that best fits its primary purpose, or "Other" when none fits, and should likewise have one ServiceSubcategory, or "Other".
items.s: Column in Cost and Usage · Mandatory · Dimension · String

items.t: ServiceName MUST adhere to the following requirements:
ServiceName MUST be of type String.
ServiceName MUST conform to StringHandling requirements.
ServiceName MUST NOT be null.
The relationship between ServiceName and ServiceCategory MUST adhere to the following requirements:
ServiceName MUST have one and only one ServiceCategory that best aligns with its primary purpose, except when no suitable ServiceCategory is available.
ServiceName MUST be associated with the ServiceCategory "Other" when no suitable ServiceCategory is available.
The relationship between ServiceName and ServiceSubcategory MUST adhere to the following requirements:
ServiceName SHOULD have one and only one ServiceSubcategory that best aligns with its primary purpose, except when no suitable ServiceSubcategory is available.
ServiceName SHOULD be associated with the ServiceSubcategory "Other" when no suitable ServiceSubcategory is available.

items.b: The name of the entity that made the resources or services available for purchase or consumption. Name of the entity that provides the resources or services available for usage or purchase, whether they are built on a host provider's infrastructure, offered as fully integrated solutions, or complementary offerings such as support, licensing or consulting. In marketplace scenarios it is the seller, not the marketplace operator; when a reseller sells white-labeled resources or services, it is the reseller; otherwise it is the entity that produced them. This Mandatory string must not be null and must conform to the String Handling requirements. It was introduced in version 1.3 to replace the removed ProviderName column.
items.s: Column in Cost and Usage · Mandatory · Dimension · String

items.t: ServiceProviderName MUST adhere to the following requirements:
ServiceProviderName MUST be of type String.
ServiceProviderName MUST conform to StringHandling requirements.
ServiceProviderName MUST NOT be null.
See Appendix: Participating Entity Identification Examples section for examples of Service Provider Name values across various use case scenarios.

items.b: Secondary classification of the Service Category for a service based on its core function. A secondary classification within a service's ServiceCategory, based on the service's core function, used with ServiceCategory to analyze spend and usage for specific workload types across service providers and to track workload migration between fundamentally different architectures. It is a Recommended String dimension that must not be null and must be one of the allowed values, each with exactly one parent ServiceCategory. Examples include Virtual Machines and Containers under Compute, Relational Databases under Databases, and Generative AI under AI and Machine Learning. Every category has an "Other" subcategory, such as "Other (Compute)", and "Other (Other)" covers services outside every category.
items.s: Column in Cost and Usage · Recommended · Dimension · String

Security Security Posture Management Tools that help organizations configure, monitor, and improve system security. Security Threat Detection and Response Collect and analyze security data to identify and respond to potential security threats and vulnerabilities. Security Other (Security) Security services that do not fall into one of the defined subcategories. Storage Backup Storage Secondary storage to protect against data loss. Storage Block Storage High performance, low latency storage that provides random access. Storage File Storage Scalable, sharable storage for file-based data. Storage Object Storage Highly available, durable storage for unstructured data. Storage Storage Platforms Unified solution that supports multiple storage types. Storage Other (Storage) Storage services that do not fall into one of the defined subcategories. Web Application Platforms Integrated environments that run web applications. Web Other (Web) Web services that do not fall into one of the defined subcategories. Other Other (Other) Services that do not fall into one of the defined categories.

items.t: ServiceSubcategory MUST adhere to the following requirements:
ServiceSubcategory MUST be of type String.
ServiceSubcategory MUST NOT be null.
ServiceSubcategory MUST be one of the allowed values.
ServiceSubcategory MUST have one and only one parent ServiceCategory as specified in the allowed values below.

items.b: Service-provider-specified unique identifier that represents a specific SKU (e.g., a quantifiable good or service offering). The service provider's unique identifier for a specific stock keeping unit (SKU), a quantifiable good or service offering with specific functionality and technical specifications that can be sold at different price points. It is a Conditional String dimension, applying when the operating model includes unit pricing. It must be null for "Tax" charges and must not be null for "Usage" and "Purchase" charges whose ChargeClass is not "Correction". For a given ServiceProviderName and SKU it must stay consistent across billing accounts, contracts, PricingCategory values and any other price factors that do not affect functionality. It may match SkuPriceId.
items.s: Column in Cost and Usage · Conditional · Dimension · String

items.t: SkuId MUST adhere to the following requirements:
SkuId MUST be of type String.
SkuId MUST conform to StringHandling requirements.
SkuId MUST adhere to the following nullability requirements:
SkuId MUST be null when ChargeCategory is "Tax".
SkuId MUST NOT be null when ChargeCategory is "Usage" or "Purchase" and ChargeClass is not "Correction".
SkuId MAY be null in all other cases.
SkuId for a given ServiceProviderName and SKU MUST adhere to the following requirements:
SkuId MUST remain consistent across billing accounts or contracts.
SkuId MUST remain consistent across PricingCategory values.
SkuId MUST remain consistent regardless of any other factors that might impact the price but do not affect the functionality of the SKU.
SkuId MUST be associated with a given resource or service when ChargeCategory is "Usage" or "Purchase".
SkuId MAY match SkuPriceId.

items.b: Describes the functionality being metered or measured by a particular SKU in a charge. A description of the functionality a particular SKU meters or measures in a charge. Providers often have several SKUs per service, such as separate object storage, data transfer and encryption SKUs for one storage service, so this shows what each SKU is metering. Examples are Compute Usage, Block Volume Usage, Data Transfer and API Requests. It is a String. It must be null when SkuId is null and should not be null when SkuId is not null, and it should remain consistent over time for a given ServiceProviderName and SkuId. The feature level is Conditional.
items.s: Column in Cost and Usage · Conditional · Dimension · String

items.t: SkuMeter MUST adhere to the following requirements:
SkuMeter MUST be of type String.
SkuMeter MUST conform to StringHandling requirements.
SkuMeter MUST adhere to the following nullability requirements:
SkuMeter MUST be null when SkuId is null.
SkuMeter SHOULD NOT be null when SkuId is not null.
SkuMeter SHOULD remain consistent over time for a given ServiceProviderName and SkuId.

items.b: A set of properties of a SKU Price ID which are meaningful and common to all instances of that SKU Price ID. Key-value properties describing a SkuPriceId: qualitative and quantitative traits of the stock keeping unit (SKU) plus stable pricing properties such as periods and tiers. Dynamic or negotiable elements like unit prices, currency, effective dates and negotiated discounts are excluded, so charges sharing a SkuPriceId should share the same details. A Conditional JSON object under the Includes Unit Pricing condition, it must be null when SkuPriceId is null and may be null otherwise. Custom keys must begin with "x_", numeric values must represent a single PricingUnit, and applicable FOCUS-defined properties such as CoreCount, ModelId and TokenDirection should be included.
items.s: Column in Cost and Usage · Conditional · Dimension · JSON

items.t: SkuPriceDetails MUST adhere to the following requirements:
SkuPriceDetails MUST be of type JSON Object (serialized as a String where necessary).
SkuPriceDetails MUST conform to StringHandling requirements.
SkuPriceDetails MUST conform to KeyValueFormat requirements.
SkuPriceDetails property keys SHOULD conform to PascalCase format.
SkuPriceDetails MUST adhere to the following nullability requirements:
SkuPriceDetails MUST be null when SkuPriceId is null.
SkuPriceDetails MAY be null when SkuPriceId is not null.
When SkuPriceDetails is not null, SkuPriceDetails MUST adhere to the following requirements:
SkuPriceDetails MUST be associated with a given SkuPriceId.
SkuPriceDetails MUST include the FOCUS-defined SKU Price property when an equivalent property is included as a custom property.
SkuPriceDetails MUST NOT include properties that are not applicable to the corresponding SkuPriceId.

SkuPriceDetails MUST NOT include TokenCacheAction when the SKU Price does not meter tokens consumed from a request (e.g., tokens generated in a response, or a charge for retaining cached content metered in token-hours).

SkuPriceDetails MUST NOT include TokenCacheAction when the SKU Price meters request tokens served from or placed into a prompt cache together with request tokens that were not (e.g., request tokens billed on one meter whether or not they were placed into a prompt cache).
SkuPriceDetails MUST NOT include TokenDirection when the SKU Price does not meter tokens (e.g., a charge for retaining cached content metered in token-hours).
SkuPriceDetails MUST NOT include TokenDirection when the SKU Price meters both tokens consumed from a request and tokens generated in a response.
SkuPriceDetails SHOULD include all FOCUS-defined SKU Price properties listed below that are applicable to the corresponding SkuPriceId.

SkuPriceDetails SHOULD include TokenCacheAction when the SKU Price meters only tokens consumed from a request, except when the SKU Price meters request tokens served from or placed into a prompt cache together with request tokens that were not.
SkuPriceDetails SHOULD include TokenDirection when the SKU Price meters only input or only output tokens.
SkuPriceDetails SHOULD include all custom SKU Price properties that are applicable to the corresponding SkuPriceId when there is no equivalent FOCUS-defined property.
SkuPriceDetails MAY include properties that are already captured in other dedicated columns.
SkuPriceDetails properties for a given ServiceProviderName and SkuPriceId MUST adhere to the following requirements:
Existing SkuPriceDetails properties SHOULD remain consistent over time.
Existing SkuPriceDetails properties SHOULD NOT be removed.
Additional SkuPriceDetails properties MAY be added over time.
Property key SHOULD remain consistent across comparable SKUs having that property, and the values for this key SHOULD remain in a consistent format.
Property key MUST begin with the string "x_" unless it is a FOCUS-defined property.
Property value MUST represent the value for a single PricingUnit when the property holds a numeric value.
FOCUS-defined SKU Price properties MUST adhere to the following requirements:
Property key MUST match the spelling and casing specified for the FOCUS-defined property.
Property value MUST be of the type specified for that property.
Property value MUST represent the value for a single PricingUnit, denominated in the unit of measure specified for that property when the property holds a numeric value.
Property value MUST be one of the allowed values specified for that property when allowed values are specified.
When included, TokenCacheAction MUST adhere to the following requirements:
TokenCacheAction MUST be "Read" when the SKU Price meters only tokens served from a prompt cache.
TokenCacheAction MUST be "Write" when the SKU Price meters only tokens placed into a prompt cache (e.g., a charge a service provider meters as cache creation).

TokenCacheAction MUST be "Uncached" when the SKU Price meters only request tokens neither served from nor placed into a prompt cache (e.g., input tokens that a service provider meters separately from its cache reads and cache writes).
TokenCacheAction MUST be "Other" when the SKU Price meters a cache-related token charge to which none of the other allowed values apply.
When included, TokenDirection MUST adhere to the following requirements:
TokenDirection MUST be "Input" when the SKU Price meters tokens consumed from a request.
TokenDirection MUST be "Output" when the SKU Price meters tokens generated in a response.

items.b: A service-provider-specified unique identifier that represents a specific SKU Price associated with a resource or service used or purchased. The service provider's identifier for one SKU Price of a resource or service used or purchased, referencing that price in the provider's price list. It must stay consistent over time and across billing accounts or contracts, which supports tracking unit price changes, and each pricing tier gets its own SkuPriceId. A Conditional String under the Includes Unit Pricing condition, it must be null when ChargeCategory is "Tax", must not be null for "Usage" or "Purchase" charges whose ChargeClass is not "Correction", and may be null otherwise. Each value must have exactly one parent SkuId and one PricingUnit per ServiceProviderName.
items.s: Column in Cost and Usage · Conditional · Dimension · String

items.t: SkuPriceId MUST adhere to the following requirements:
SkuPriceId MUST be of type String.
SkuPriceId MUST conform to StringHandling requirements.
SkuPriceId MUST adhere to the following nullability requirements:
SkuPriceId MUST be null when ChargeCategory is "Tax".
SkuPriceId MUST NOT be null when ChargeCategory is "Usage" or "Purchase" and ChargeClass is not "Correction".
SkuPriceId MAY be null in all other cases.
When SkuPriceId is not null, SkuPriceId MUST adhere to the following requirements:
SkuPriceId MUST have one and only one parent SkuId for a given ServiceProviderName.
SkuPriceId MUST have one and only one PricingUnit for a given ServiceProviderName.
SkuPriceId MUST NOT be associated with both a "Usage" ChargeCategory and a "Purchase" ChargeCategory for a given ServiceProviderName.
SkuPriceId for a given ServiceProviderName and SKU Price MUST adhere to the following requirements:
SkuPriceId MUST remain consistent over time.
SkuPriceId MUST remain consistent across billing accounts or contracts.
SkuPriceId MAY match SkuId.
SkuPriceId MUST be associated with a given resource or service when ChargeCategory is "Usage" or "Purchase".
SkuPriceId MUST reference a SKU Price in a service-provider-supplied price list, enabling the lookup of detailed information about the SKU Price.
SkuPriceId MUST have one and only one ListUnitPrice for a given ServiceProviderName, BillingCurrency, and ChargePeriodStart.
SkuPriceId MUST have one and only one ContractedUnitPrice for a given ServiceProviderName, contract, BillingAccountId, BillingCurrency, and ChargePeriodStart.
See Examples: Commitment Discount Flexibility for more details around commitment discount flexibility.

items.b: An ID assigned to a grouping of resources or services, often used to manage access and/or cost. The service provider's identifier for a sub account, a grouping of resources or services often used to manage access, cost or both; it is commonly used for grouping by organizational constructs, access management and cost allocation. It is a Conditional String dimension in the Cost and Usage dataset, applying when the operating model includes sub accounts, and must conform to the String Handling requirements. It must be null when a charge is not related to a sub account and must not be null when a charge is related to one.
items.s: Column in Cost and Usage · Conditional · Dimension · String

items.t: SubAccountId MUST adhere to the following requirements:
SubAccountId MUST be of type String.
SubAccountId MUST conform to StringHandling requirements.
SubAccountId MUST adhere to the following nullability requirements:
SubAccountId MUST be null when a charge is not related to a sub account.
SubAccountId MUST NOT be null when a charge is related to a sub account.
See Appendix: Grouping constructs for resources or services for details and examples of the different grouping constructs supported by FOCUS.

items.b: A name assigned to a grouping of resources or services, often used to manage access and/or cost. A sub account's display name, where a sub account is a grouping of resources or services often used to manage access, cost or both. It supports grouping by organizational constructs, access management needs and cost allocation strategies. It is a Conditional String dimension under the Includes Sub Accounts operating model condition and must follow string handling requirements. It must be null when SubAccountId is null and must not be null when SubAccountId is not null. An appendix describes the grouping constructs FOCUS supports.
items.s: Column in Cost and Usage · Conditional · Dimension · String

items.t: SubAccountName MUST adhere to the following requirements:
SubAccountName MUST be of type String.
SubAccountName MUST conform to StringHandling requirements.
SubAccountName MUST adhere to the following nullability requirements:
SubAccountName MUST be null when SubAccountId is null.
SubAccountName MUST NOT be null when SubAccountId is not null.
See Appendix: Grouping constructs for resources or services for details and examples of the different grouping constructs supported by FOCUS.

items.b: A service-provider-assigned name to identify the type of sub account. The type of a sub account, given as a service-provider-assigned readable display name rather than a code. It is commonly used to map FOCUS and service provider constructs, summarize costs across service providers, or support invoicing and chargeback. It is a Conditional String dimension under the Includes Multiple Sub Account Types operating model condition, must follow string handling requirements and must be a consistent, readable display value. It must be null when SubAccountId is null and must not be null when SubAccountId is not null.
items.s: Column in Cost and Usage · Conditional · Dimension · String

items.t: SubAccountType MUST adhere to the following requirements:
SubAccountType MUST be of type String.
SubAccountType MUST conform to StringHandling requirements.
SubAccountType MUST adhere to the following nullability requirements:
SubAccountType MUST be null when SubAccountId is null.
SubAccountType MUST NOT be null when SubAccountId is not null.
SubAccountType MUST be a consistent, readable display value.

items.b: The set of tags assigned to tag sources that account for potential provider-defined or user-defined tag evaluations. The set of tags assigned to tag sources, used to add business context for allocating charges. A Conditional dimension, applying when the operating model includes tags, it holds a JSON object that must conform to the Key-Value Format requirements and may be null. When present it must include all user-defined and provider-defined tags but only finalized ones, with one value selected per key; valueless keys must be set to true. Provider-defined keys must carry a provider-specified prefix unique to their tag scheme, while user-defined keys must not carry a scheme prefix when only one user-defined tag scheme exists.
items.s: Column in Cost and Usage · Conditional · Dimension · JSON

items.t: Tags MUST adhere to the following requirements:
Tags MUST be of type JSON Object (serialized as a String where necessary).
Tags MUST conform to StringHandling requirements.
Tags MUST conform to KeyValueFormat requirements.
Tags MAY be null.
When Tags is not null, Tags MUST adhere to the following requirements:
Tags MUST include all user-defined and provider-defined tags.
Tags MUST only include finalized tags.
Tags SHOULD include tag keys with corresponding non-null values for a given resource.
Tags MAY include tag keys with a null value for a given resource depending on the data generator's tag finalization process.
Tag keys that do not support corresponding values, MUST have a corresponding true (boolean) value set.
Tag values MUST match the provided values unless true (boolean) is applied to valueless tags.
Provider-defined tags MUST adhere to the following requirements:
Provider-defined tag keys MUST be prefixed with a predetermined, provider-specified tag key prefix that is unique to each corresponding provider-specified tag scheme.
Provider-specified tag key prefixes SHOULD be publicly documented.
User-defined tags MUST adhere to the following requirements:
User-defined tag keys MUST match the tag keys assigned to the tag source when no tag scheme-specific prefix is prepended.
User-defined tag keys MUST match the tag scheme-specific prefix followed by the tag key assigned to the tag source when a tag scheme-specific prefix is prepended.

User-defined tag keys in all but one user-defined tag scheme MUST include a predetermined, provider-specified tag key prefix that is unique to each corresponding user-defined tag scheme when the data generator has more than one user-defined tag scheme.
User-defined tag keys MUST NOT include a tag scheme-specific prefix when the data generator has only one user-defined tag scheme.
Reserved tag key prefixes MUST be prevented from being used as prefixes for any user-defined tag keys within a prefixless user-defined tag scheme.
Tag finalization documentation MUST adhere to the following requirements:
Tag finalization documentation SHOULD include tag finalization methods and semantics.
Tag finalization documentation SHOULD be accessible to practitioners.

items.b: Represents the highest-level classification of a SKU Price based on whether it is a usage rate, a purchase fee, or a credit value. The highest-level classification of a stock keeping unit (SKU) price by what is being priced, separating published rates for consumption-based usage, published fees for upfront or recurring purchases, and published unit values for granted credits. It is a Mandatory String dimension that must not be null and must be one of three allowed values, "Usage", "Purchase" or "Credit". Unlike the Cost and Usage column of the same name, it has no "Tax" or "Adjustment" values by design, because service providers do not publish SKU prices for them. It was introduced as a preview in version 1.5.
items.s: Column in SKU Price · Mandatory · Dimension · String
items.x: Value Description Usage The published unit price for the quantity of a service or resource that is consumed over a given period of time. Purchase The published fee for the acquisition of a service, resource, or commitment bought upfront or on a recurring basis. Credit The published unit value of a credit granted by the service provider (e.g., a promotional credit carrying a defined unit value).

items.t: ChargeCategory MUST adhere to the following requirements:
ChargeCategory MUST be of type String.
ChargeCategory MUST NOT be null.
ChargeCategory MUST be one of the allowed values.
ChargeCategory MUST be "Usage" when the SKU Price represents the rate for consumption of a service or resource.
ChargeCategory MUST be "Purchase" when the SKU Price represents a fee for the acquisition of a service, resource, or commitment.
ChargeCategory MUST be "Credit" when the SKU Price represents the unit value of a credit granted by the service provider.

items.b: Indicates whether the commitment discount a SKU Price record relates to is based on usage quantity or cost (aka "spend"). The basis of the commitment discount a SkuPrice record relates to: usage quantity or cost, also called spend. It applies only to commitment discounts, not negotiated discounts. A Conditional String under the Includes Commitment Discounts condition, introduced as a preview in version 1.5, it must be "Spend", for discounts requiring a predetermined amount of spend, or "Usage", for those requiring a predetermined amount of usage. It must not be null when the record represents a commitment discount purchase or a usage rate that applies under one, and must be null otherwise.
items.s: Column in SKU Price · Conditional · Dimension · String
items.x: Value Description Spend Commitment discounts that require a predetermined amount of spend. Usage Commitment discounts that require a predetermined amount of usage.

items.t: CommitmentDiscountCategory MUST adhere to the following requirements:
CommitmentDiscountCategory MUST be of type String.
CommitmentDiscountCategory MUST adhere to the following nullability requirements:
CommitmentDiscountCategory MUST be null when the SkuPrice record does not represent the purchase of a commitment discount or a usage rate that applies under a commitment discount.
CommitmentDiscountCategory MUST NOT be null when the SkuPrice record represents the purchase of a commitment discount or a usage rate that applies under a commitment discount.
CommitmentDiscountCategory MUST be one of the allowed values.

items.b: A service-provider-assigned identifier for a contract describing the agreed terms between a service provider and a customer. A service-provider-assigned identifier for a contract with a customer; a null value marks a public list price not tied to a contract. The Contract Commitment dataset holds the contract's terms. It is a String. It must be null when the record is not contract-specific or UnitPriceType is "List", and must not be null when it is contract-specific or UnitPriceType is "Base" or "Contracted". When present it must be unique within the service provider and should be fully qualified. Only SkuPriceEligibility determines which entities are eligible for the price. The feature level is Mandatory; introduced as a 1.5 preview.
items.s: Column in SKU Price · Mandatory · Dimension · String

items.t: ContractId MUST adhere to the following requirements:
ContractId MUST be of type String.
ContractId MUST conform to StringHandling requirements.
ContractId MUST adhere to the following nullability requirements:
ContractId MUST be null when the SkuPrice record does not represent a price specific to a contract.
ContractId MUST be null when UnitPriceType is "List".
ContractId MUST NOT be null when the SkuPrice record represents a price specific to a contract.
ContractId MUST NOT be null when UnitPriceType is "Base" or "Contracted".
When ContractId is not null, ContractId MUST adhere to the following requirements:
ContractId MUST be a unique identifier within the service provider.
ContractId SHOULD be a fully-qualified identifier.

items.b: The national currency or consumption currency denomination that a resource or service is priced in. The currency a resource or service is priced in, which may be a national currency or a consumption currency, regardless of the currency it is ultimately billed in. It is a String that must conform to string handling and currency format requirements, must not be null, and must represent a national currency or a consumption currency. Its documentation must be accessible to practitioners and must specify how to determine whether a value represents a national currency. The feature level is Mandatory. It is a dimension in the SKU Price dataset, introduced as a preview in version 1.5.
items.s: Column in SKU Price · Mandatory · Dimension · String

items.t: PricingCurrency MUST adhere to the following requirements:
PricingCurrency MUST be of type String.
PricingCurrency MUST conform to StringHandling requirements.
PricingCurrency MUST conform to CurrencyFormat requirements.
PricingCurrency MUST NOT be null.
PricingCurrency MUST represent a national currency or a consumption currency.
PricingCurrency documentation MUST adhere to the following requirements:
PricingCurrency documentation MUST specify how to determine whether a value represents a national currency.
PricingCurrency documentation MUST be accessible to practitioners.

items.b: Categorizes the nature of the Pricing Currency as either a financial instrument the customer can pay in ("Payable") or a proprietary consumption currency issued by the service provider ("Consumable"). Whether a SkuPrice record's PricingCurrency is a national currency the customer can pay in or a consumption currency issued by the service provider. It is a Mandatory String dimension that must not be null and must be one of two allowed values: "Payable" when PricingCurrency represents a national currency, and "Consumable" when it represents a consumption currency, such as platform credits. Multiplying usage by a "Payable" rate gives a base financial cost, needing currency conversion only if the billed currency differs, while a "Consumable" rate gives a virtual cost balance that requires a secondary conversion to reach the financial cost.
items.s: Column in SKU Price · Mandatory · Dimension · String
items.x: Value Description Payable The pricing currency represents a financial medium of exchange the customer can pay in: a national currency (e.g., USD, EUR, JPY). Math resulting from this rate yields a base financial cost, though a currency conversion step may still be required if the customer's actual billed currency differs. Consumable The pricing currency represents a service-provider-specific consumption currency (e.g., platform credits, normalized billing units). Math resulting from this rate yields a virtual cost balance within the provider's ecosystem, requiring a mandatory secondary conversion to determine the financial cost.

items.t: PricingCurrencyCategory MUST adhere to the following requirements:
PricingCurrencyCategory MUST be of type String.
PricingCurrencyCategory MUST NOT be null.
PricingCurrencyCategory MUST be one of the allowed values.
PricingCurrencyCategory MUST be "Payable" when PricingCurrency represents a national currency.
PricingCurrencyCategory MUST be "Consumable" when PricingCurrency represents a consumption currency.

items.b: Service-provider-assigned identifier for an isolated geographic area where the specified SKU Price applies. A service-provider-assigned identifier for the geographic area where a price in the SkuPrice dataset applies, used to join rates to actual usage. This Conditional string, tied to operating models that include regions, must represent the provider's own regional construct, even a global or macro-region. It must not be null when the price is specific to a distinct region and may be null when it applies globally or is not regionally scoped. Unlike RegionId, it marks where the rate is valid, not where a resource is provisioned. A null or "global" value cannot reliably separate worldwide from non-regionalized scope.
items.s: Column in SKU Price · Conditional · Dimension · String

items.t: PricingRegionId MUST adhere to the following requirements:
PricingRegionId MUST be of type String.
PricingRegionId MUST conform to StringHandling requirements.
PricingRegionId MUST represent the geographic boundary or regional construct explicitly defined by the service provider for the SKU Price, even when this represents a global or macro-region scope.
PricingRegionId MUST adhere to the following nullability requirements:
PricingRegionId MUST NOT be null when the SKU Price is specific to a distinct region.
PricingRegionId MAY be null when the SKU Price applies globally or is not regionally scoped.

items.b: A display name for the service under which the specified SKU Price is published in the service provider's price list. Display name of the service under which a price in the SkuPrice dataset is published in the service provider's price list, used to compare unit prices across services or filter price lists. This Mandatory string must not be null, must conform to the String Handling requirements and must represent the service offering the provider defines for the price, even when it groups several distinct underlying services. It can differ from ServiceName in Cost and Usage, which names the service of the actual usage; those ServiceName values can instead be captured as inclusion criteria in SkuPriceEligibility.
items.s: Column in SKU Price · Mandatory · Dimension · String

items.t: PricingServiceName MUST adhere to the following requirements:
PricingServiceName MUST be of type String.
PricingServiceName MUST conform to StringHandling requirements.

PricingServiceName MUST represent the service offering explicitly defined by the service provider for the SKU Price, even when this represents a grouping or abstraction of multiple distinct underlying services.
PricingServiceName MUST NOT be null.

items.b: Service-provider-specified measurement unit used to define the unit price of an offering (e.g., Hours, GB-Months, 1,000 Tokens). The service-provider-specified measurement unit in which an offering's unit price is defined, such as Hours, GB-Months or 1,000,000 Tokens. Unlike the Consumed Unit in Cost and Usage data, it follows the provider's rate card and is often coarser than raw usage measurement. It is a String that should conform to the unit format and must not be null. When a record prices a currency, PricingUnit must match a PricingCurrency value of records whose PricingCurrencyCategory is "Consumable". It differs from PricingCurrency: a token is a unit of processing, not a currency. The feature level is Mandatory; introduced as a 1.5 preview.
items.s: Column in SKU Price · Mandatory · Dimension · String

items.t: PricingUnit MUST adhere to the following requirements:
PricingUnit MUST be of type String.
PricingUnit MUST conform to StringHandling requirements.
PricingUnit SHOULD conform to UnitFormat requirements.
PricingUnit MUST NOT be null.
PricingUnit MUST match a PricingCurrency value of records whose PricingCurrencyCategory is "Consumable" when the SkuPrice record represents the price of that currency.

items.b: Represents the categorical length of the term of a purchase. The categorical length of a purchase's term, such as "1 Year" or "3 Years", based on the commercial agreement or pricing model; for a commitment discount, it is that discount's term. As a stable classifier, a three-year term exchanged after a few months stays "3 Years". A Conditional String under the Includes Purchases condition, and a preview in version 1.5, it must be null when ChargeCategory is "Usage" or "Credit" and may be null for "Purchase". It should be a positive integer then a time unit such as Week or Years, matching the offering's standard duration rather than exact days or hours.
items.s: Column in SKU Price · Conditional · Dimension · String
items.x: Time Unit Minute Minutes Hour Hours Day Days Week Weeks Month Months Quarter Quarters Year Years

items.t: PurchaseDurationType MUST adhere to the following requirements:
PurchaseDurationType MUST be of type String.
PurchaseDurationType MUST conform to StringHandling requirements.
PurchaseDurationType MUST adhere to the following nullability requirements:
PurchaseDurationType MUST be null when ChargeCategory is "Usage".
PurchaseDurationType MUST be null when ChargeCategory is "Credit".
PurchaseDurationType MAY be null when ChargeCategory is "Purchase".
PurchaseDurationType SHOULD use the "[Numeric Value] [Unit]" format (e.g., "1 Day", "1 Year", "3 Months", "3 Years").
PurchaseDurationType SHOULD present the unit of time as one of the allowed values.
PurchaseDurationType SHOULD correspond to the standard duration of the purchased offering (e.g., "1 Year", "3 Years") rather than a precise calculation of days or hours.

items.b: Defines the financial settlement structure of a purchase. The settlement structure of a purchase: one upfront payment, recurring charges, or both over the PurchaseDurationType; for a commitment discount it describes that commitment discount's settlement. It is a Conditional String dimension in the SkuPrice dataset under the Includes Purchases operating model condition, introduced as a preview in version 1.5. It must be null when ChargeCategory is "Usage" or "Credit", must not be null when it is "Purchase", and must be one of "No Upfront", "Partial Upfront" or "All Upfront". Each payment model offered is published as a separate SKU price record, even at the same price.
items.s: Column in SKU Price · Conditional · Dimension · String
items.x: Value Sort Order Description Typical Use Case No Upfront 10 The obligation is settled entirely through deferred payment(s) (typically multiple recurring charges) with no initial payment. Pay-as-you-go Savings Plans or monthly-billed SaaS. Partial Upfront 20 The obligation is settled through a combination of an initial payment and deferred payment(s) (typically multiple recurring charges). Hybrid RIs or EAs with a "Year 1" deposit plus installments. All Upfront 30 The total obligation is settled via a single payment at the start of the duration. High-discount RIs or multi-year contracts paid in full Day 1.

items.t: PurchasePaymentModel MUST adhere to the following requirements:
PurchasePaymentModel MUST be of type String.
PurchasePaymentModel MUST adhere to the following nullability requirements:
PurchasePaymentModel MUST be null when ChargeCategory is "Usage".
PurchasePaymentModel MUST be null when ChargeCategory is "Credit".
PurchasePaymentModel MUST NOT be null when ChargeCategory is "Purchase".
PurchasePaymentModel MUST be one of the allowed values.

items.b: The inclusive upper boundary of a quantity-based pricing tier, measured in the designated Pricing Unit. The inclusive upper boundary of a quantity-based pricing tier for a SkuPrice record, measured in its PricingUnit. With QuantityTierMinimum, the exclusive lower bound, it defines the quantity range for a unit price: a quantity is in the tier when it is greater than the minimum and no more than the maximum. A Conditional Decimal metric, applying when the operating model includes quantity tier pricing, it must be null when the tier has no upper limit, as for the highest tier or a flat rate, must not be null when a higher tier exists, and must be strictly greater than QuantityTierMinimum.
items.s: Column in SKU Price · Conditional · Metric · Decimal

items.t: QuantityTierMaximum MUST adhere to the following requirements:
QuantityTierMaximum MUST be of type Decimal.
QuantityTierMaximum MUST conform to NumericFormat requirements.
QuantityTierMaximum MUST adhere to the following nullability requirements:
QuantityTierMaximum MUST be null when there is no upper limit for the pricing tier.
QuantityTierMaximum MUST NOT be null when a subsequent, higher-quantity pricing tier exists for the same offering.
When QuantityTierMaximum is not null, QuantityTierMaximum MUST adhere to the following requirements:
QuantityTierMaximum MUST represent a quantity denominated in the PricingUnit.
QuantityTierMaximum MUST be strictly greater than QuantityTierMinimum.
QuantityTierMaximum MUST be the inclusive upper bound of the quantity-based pricing tier.

items.b: The exclusive lower boundary of a quantity-based pricing tier, measured in the designated Pricing Unit. The exclusive lower boundary of a quantity-based pricing tier for a SKU Price, measured in the PricingUnit: the unit price applies to quantities above this threshold. Together with Quantity Tier Maximum it defines the exact quantity range for a unit price, and for flat-rate or non-tiered pricing it is typically zero. It is a non-negative Decimal that must not be null. The feature level is Conditional, under the operating model condition Includes Quantity Tier Pricing. It is a metric in the SKU Price dataset, introduced as a preview in version 1.5.
items.s: Column in SKU Price · Conditional · Metric · Decimal

items.t: QuantityTierMinimum MUST adhere to the following requirements:
QuantityTierMinimum MUST be of type Decimal.
QuantityTierMinimum MUST conform to NumericFormat requirements.
QuantityTierMinimum MUST NOT be null.
QuantityTierMinimum MUST be a non-negative decimal value.
QuantityTierMinimum MUST represent a quantity denominated in the PricingUnit.
QuantityTierMinimum MUST be the exclusive lower bound of the quantity-based pricing tier.

items.b: The name of the entity that provides the resources or services to which the specified SKU Price applies. The name of the entity providing the resources or services to which a SKU Price applies, including complementary offerings such as support, licensing or consulting. It is commonly used to filter rate cards by vendor or compare providers' prices. In marketplace scenarios it is the seller, not the marketplace operator; for a reseller selling white-labeled resources or services it is the reseller; otherwise it is the entity that produced them. It is a Mandatory String in the SkuPrice dataset, introduced as a preview in version 1.5, that must conform to the String Handling requirements and must not be null.
items.s: Column in SKU Price · Mandatory · Dimension · String

items.t: ServiceProviderName MUST adhere to the following requirements:
ServiceProviderName MUST be of type String.
ServiceProviderName MUST conform to StringHandling requirements.
ServiceProviderName MUST NOT be null.
See the Appendix: Participating Entity Identification Examples section for examples of Service Provider Name values across various use case scenarios.

items.b: Service-provider-specified unique identifier that represents a specific SKU (e.g., a quantifiable good or service offering). A service-provider-specified unique identifier for a stock keeping unit (SKU): a quantifiable good or service offering with specific functionality and technical specifications, such as a per-user subscription seat or consulting hours. Each SkuId can carry several SKU Prices varying by tier, commitment period or negotiated terms. It is the primary identifier for looking up a SKU in a provider's catalog or price list and for joining rate card data with usage. A Mandatory String in SkuPrice, it must not be null and must stay consistent across contracts and any factors that affect price but not functionality.
items.s: Column in SKU Price · Mandatory · Dimension · String

items.t: SkuId MUST adhere to the following requirements:
SkuId MUST be of type String.
SkuId MUST conform to StringHandling requirements.
SkuId MUST NOT be null.
SkuId for a given SKU MUST adhere to the following requirements:
SkuId MUST remain consistent across contracts or billing agreements.
SkuId MUST remain consistent regardless of any other factors that might impact the price but do not affect the functionality of the SKU.

items.b: The timestamp when the SKU Price record was first created. The timestamp at which a SKU Price record was first created, meaning the moment the record was instantiated. It supports auditing of the rate card publication lifecycle by letting practitioners distinguish when the provider generated a pricing record from when it becomes effective, which SKU Price Effective Start records. It is a Date/Time that must conform to date/time format requirements and must not be null. The feature level is Mandatory. It is a dimension in the SKU Price dataset, introduced as a preview in version 1.5.
items.s: Column in SKU Price · Mandatory · Dimension · Date/Time

items.t: SkuPriceCreated MUST adhere to the following requirements:
SkuPriceCreated MUST be of type Date/Time.
SkuPriceCreated MUST conform to DateTimeFormat requirements.
SkuPriceCreated MUST NOT be null.
SkuPriceCreated MUST represent the moment in time the SKU Price record was instantiated.

items.b: Self-contained summary of the SKU Price's purpose and offering. A self-contained, high-level summary of a SKU Price's purpose, offering and unit price that gives context without further discovery. It typically covers a select group of details found elsewhere in the SkuPrice dataset or provides information not otherwise available. It is a Mandatory String dimension, introduced as a preview in version 1.5, that must conform to the String Handling requirements and must not be null. Its maximum length should be provided in the corresponding FOCUS Metadata Schema.
items.s: Column in SKU Price · Mandatory · Dimension · String

items.t: SkuPriceDescription MUST adhere to the following requirements:
SkuPriceDescription MUST be of type String.
SkuPriceDescription MUST conform to StringHandling requirements.
SkuPriceDescription MUST NOT be null.
SkuPriceDescription maximum length SHOULD be provided in the corresponding FOCUS Metadata Schema.

items.b: The exclusive date and time when the specified SKU Price record is no longer active or applicable. The exclusive date and time from which a SkuPrice record is no longer active; with SkuPriceEffectiveStart it defines the validity window of a rate card entry. This Mandatory Date/Time column must be null when the price has no upper time boundary, including a price published ahead of taking effect, and must not be null when it has a designated end. A null does not mean the price is currently in effect. It must be greater than SkuPriceEffectiveStart when both are not null. A charge falls under the price when its ChargePeriodStart is before this value or the value is null.
items.s: Column in SKU Price · Mandatory · Dimension · Date/Time

items.t: SkuPriceEffectiveEnd MUST adhere to the following requirements:
SkuPriceEffectiveEnd MUST be of type Date/Time.
SkuPriceEffectiveEnd MUST conform to DateTimeFormat requirements (e.g., UTC).
SkuPriceEffectiveEnd MUST adhere to the following nullability requirements:
SkuPriceEffectiveEnd MUST be null when the SkuPrice record is applicable without an upper time boundary.
SkuPriceEffectiveEnd MUST NOT be null when the SkuPrice record has a designated timestamp from which it is no longer applicable.
SkuPriceEffectiveEnd MUST be the exclusive end bound of the effective period of the SkuPrice record when SkuPriceEffectiveEnd is not null.
SkuPriceEffectiveEnd MUST be greater than SkuPriceEffectiveStart when SkuPriceEffectiveStart is not null and SkuPriceEffectiveEnd is not null.

items.b: The inclusive date and time when the specified SKU Price record becomes active and applicable. The inclusive date and time from which a SkuPrice record applies to a given SkuPriceId, reflecting when the price becomes contractually or publicly applicable rather than when a practitioner first uses the SKU. A CostAndUsage charge falls under the price when its ChargePeriodStart is on or after this value, and with SkuPriceEffectiveEnd it defines a rate card entry's validity window. A Mandatory Date/Time dimension introduced as a preview in version 1.5, it must be null when the record has no lower time boundary and must not be null when it has a designated start; a null means unbounded, not unknown.
items.s: Column in SKU Price · Mandatory · Dimension · Date/Time

items.t: SkuPriceEffectiveStart MUST adhere to the following requirements:
SkuPriceEffectiveStart MUST be of type Date/Time.
SkuPriceEffectiveStart MUST conform to DateTimeFormat requirements (e.g., UTC).
SkuPriceEffectiveStart MUST adhere to the following nullability requirements:
SkuPriceEffectiveStart MUST be null when the SkuPrice record is applicable without a lower time boundary.
SkuPriceEffectiveStart MUST NOT be null when the SkuPrice record has a designated timestamp from which it becomes applicable.
SkuPriceEffectiveStart MUST be the inclusive start bound of the effective period of the SkuPrice record when SkuPriceEffectiveStart is not null.

items.b: A structured definition of the specific entities, accounts, or contexts eligible for the specified SKU Price record. A JSON object of inclusion and exclusion rules stating which entities, accounts or contexts are eligible for a SkuPrice record. A Mandatory dimension, it must not be null and must conform to the JSON Object Format and SkuPriceEligibilityObject requirements. IsGlobalScope must be true when eligibility is not restricted to an enumerated set of entities, like a standard public list price, and IsComplexScope must be true when the logic exceeds schema capabilities. Each rule names a Dimension, which should be a Cost and Usage column, an operator such as In or Exists, and Values, where the wildcard "*" must appear alone.
items.s: Column in SKU Price · Mandatory · Dimension · JSON

items.t: SkuPriceEligibility MUST adhere to the following requirements:
SkuPriceEligibility MUST be of type JSON Object (serialized as a String where necessary).
SkuPriceEligibility MUST conform to StringHandling requirements.
SkuPriceEligibility MUST conform to JsonObjectFormat requirements.
SkuPriceEligibility MUST conform to SkuPriceEligibilityObject requirements.
SkuPriceEligibility MUST NOT be null.

items.b: A service-provider-specified unique identifier that represents a specific SKU Price. A service-provider-specified unique identifier for a specific stock keeping unit (SKU) price, the primary reference key for that price in a provider's price list. A mandatory String dimension introduced as a preview in version 1.5, it must not be null. Each SkuPriceId must have exactly one parent SkuId, PricingUnit and ChargeCategory, and, where quantity tier pricing applies, one QuantityTierMinimum and one QuantityTierMaximum, which can be null. It must stay consistent over time and across contracts or billing agreements, as dynamic and negotiable properties such as unit price and currency are excluded from it. It may match SkuId.
items.s: Column in SKU Price · Mandatory · Dimension · String

items.t: SkuPriceId MUST adhere to the following requirements:
SkuPriceId MUST be of type String.
SkuPriceId MUST conform to StringHandling requirements.
SkuPriceId MUST NOT be null.
SkuPriceId MUST have one and only one parent SkuId.
SkuPriceId MUST have one and only one PricingUnit.
SkuPriceId MUST have one and only one ChargeCategory.
SkuPriceId MUST have one and only one QuantityTierMinimum when the operating model includes quantity tier pricing.
SkuPriceId MUST have one and only one QuantityTierMaximum (including null) when the operating model includes quantity tier pricing.
SkuPriceId MUST remain consistent over time.
SkuPriceId MUST remain consistent across contracts or billing agreements.
SkuPriceId MAY match SkuId.

items.b: The timestamp when the SKU Price record was last updated. When a SkuPrice record was last updated: the most recent moment any of its column values was created or modified, helping FinOps practitioners confirm they hold the current version of a rate card record after corrections or metadata updates. It is a mandatory Date/Time dimension, introduced as a preview in version 1.5, that must follow date/time format requirements, must not be null and must be greater than or equal to SkuPriceCreated. It may be later than SkuPriceEffectiveEnd, because corrections can be applied to a retired rate, so price history should be rebuilt from SkuPriceEffectiveStart and SkuPriceEffectiveEnd rather than audit timestamps.
items.s: Column in SKU Price · Mandatory · Dimension · Date/Time

items.t: SkuPriceLastUpdated MUST adhere to the following requirements:
SkuPriceLastUpdated MUST be of type Date/Time.
SkuPriceLastUpdated MUST conform to DateTimeFormat requirements.
SkuPriceLastUpdated MUST NOT be null.
SkuPriceLastUpdated MUST represent the most recent moment in time when any column value of the SKU Price record was created or modified.
SkuPriceLastUpdated MUST be greater than or equal to SkuPriceCreated.

> Note: SKU Price Last Updated reflects when the SKU Price record was last modified and may be later than SKU Price Effective End, because corrections to a record's descriptive or pricing properties can be applied to a retired rate after its effective window has closed. Practitioners reconstructing price history should key on SKU Price Effective Start and SKU Price Effective End rather than on the record audit timestamps.

items.b: The service-provider-published unit price for a single Pricing Unit of the associated SKU Price. The service-provider-published price for a single Pricing Unit of the associated SKU Price, in the PricingCurrency. When Contract ID is null it is the standard public price; when populated it is specific to that contract, and Unit Price Type shows which kind, for example a "Base" list price fixed for the contract or a "Contracted" rate. It is a non-negative Decimal that must not be null, and values should only be viewed in the context of their row, not aggregated. The feature level is Mandatory. It was introduced as a preview in version 1.5.
items.s: Column in SKU Price · Mandatory · Metric · Decimal

items.t: UnitPrice MUST adhere to the following requirements:
UnitPrice MUST be of type Decimal.
UnitPrice MUST conform to NumericFormat requirements.
UnitPrice MUST NOT be null.
UnitPrice MUST be a non-negative decimal value.
UnitPrice MUST be denominated in the PricingCurrency.

items.b: Categorizes the monetary value in Unit Price. The category of rate held in UnitPrice, distinguishing a standard public price, a contract baseline, a negotiated price or a provider-specific type. A mandatory String dimension introduced as a preview in version 1.5, it must not be null. It should use the recommended values "List" for a price not specific to a contract, "Base" for a list unit price fixed for a ContractId at a point in time, and "Contracted" for a contracted unit price for a ContractId, and may use provider-specific values when none fits. It must not be "Base" or "Contracted" unless the record fits that meaning.
items.s: Column in SKU Price · Mandatory · Dimension · String

items.t: UnitPriceType MUST adhere to the following requirements:
UnitPriceType MUST be of type String.
UnitPriceType MUST conform to StringHandling requirements.
UnitPriceType MUST NOT be null.
UnitPriceType MUST NOT be "Base" when the SkuPrice record does not represent the list unit price at a point in time, fixed for a given ContractId.
UnitPriceType MUST NOT be "Contracted" when the SkuPrice record does not represent a contracted unit price for a given ContractId.
UnitPriceType SHOULD use one of the recommended values when the price model aligns with a defined concept.
UnitPriceType SHOULD be "List" when the SkuPrice record does not represent a price specific to a contract.
UnitPriceType SHOULD be "Base" when the SkuPrice record represents a price specific to a contract and that price is a list price fixed for the contract at a point in time.
UnitPriceType SHOULD be "Contracted" when the SkuPrice record represents a price specific to a contract and that price is not a list price fixed for the contract at a point in time.
UnitPriceType MAY contain provider-specific values when the price model does not align with a recommended value.

items.b: Cost of a charge as invoiced by the invoice issuer in a given billing period. Cost of a charge as invoiced by the invoice issuer in a billing period, in the BillingCurrency, used for invoice reconciliation, cash-based forecasting, budgeting and cost allocation. This Mandatory Decimal must not be null, must reflect all applicable pricing adjustments, must exclude any covered portion offset by a covering charge, and must be 0 for fully covered charges. When InvoiceIssueStatus is "Issued", its sum per InvoiceDetailId, InvoiceId and InvoiceIssuerName must equal the invoice's payable amount. Sums compared with CostAndUsage.BilledCost must stay within the rounding variance tolerance, except when InvoiceIssueStatus is "Open" or, in the invoice-level comparison, ChargeCategory is "Tax".
items.s: Column in Invoice Detail · Mandatory · Metric · Decimal

items.t: BilledCost MUST adhere to the following requirements:
BilledCost MUST be of type Decimal.
BilledCost MUST conform to NumericFormat requirements.
BilledCost MUST NOT be null.
BilledCost MUST be denominated in the BillingCurrency.
